table_query:
SELECT
  ProductID,
  Name AS ProductName,
  ProductNumber,
  MakeFlag,
  FinishedGoodsFlag,
  Color,
  Size,
  SizeUnitMeasureCode,
  Weight,
  WeightUnitMeasureCode,
  ProductLine,
  Class,
  Style,
  StandardCost,
  ListPrice,
  DaysToManufacture,
  ProductSubcategoryID,
  ProductModelID,
  CAST(SellStartDate AS DATE)    AS SellStartDate,
  CAST(SellEndDate AS DATE)      AS SellEndDate,
  CAST(DiscontinuedDate AS DATE) AS DiscontinuedDate
FROM silver.yasilvermodel.Production_Product
column_expressions: CAST(UNHEX(SHA2(CONCAT(IFNULL(CAST(`ProductName` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`ProductNumber` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`MakeFlag` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`FinishedGoodsFlag` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Color` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Size` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`SizeUnitMeasureCode` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Weight` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`WeightUnitMeasureCode` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`ProductLine` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Class` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`Style` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`StandardCost` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`ListPrice` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`DaysToManufacture` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`ProductSubcategoryID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`ProductModelID` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`SellStartDate` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`SellEndDate` AS STRING), 'NULL'), '|', IFNULL(CAST(`DiscontinuedDate` AS STRING), 'NULL')), 256)) AS BINARY)
create_table_ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gold.yagoldmodel2.DimProduct (
  `ProductKey` BINARY,
  `ProductID` INT,
  `ProductName` STRING,
  `ProductNumber` STRING,
  `MakeFlag` BOOLEAN,
  `FinishedGoodsFlag` BOOLEAN,
  `Color` STRING,
  `Size` STRING,
  `SizeUnitMeasureCode` STRING,
  `Weight` DECIMAL(8,2),
  `WeightUnitMeasureCode` STRING,
  `ProductLine` STRING,
  `Class` STRING,
  `Style` STRING,
  `StandardCost` DECIMAL(19,4),
  `ListPrice` DECIMAL(19,4),
  `DaysToManufacture` INT,
  `ProductSubcategoryID` INT,
  `ProductModelID` INT,
  `SellStartDate` DATE,
  `SellEndDate` DATE,
  `DiscontinuedDate` DATE,
  `ProductKey_Id` BIGINT,
  Audit_CreatedDateTime TIMESTAMP,
  Audit_ModifiedDateTime TIMESTAMP,
  ChangeHash BINARY
)
USING delta
